title: Rational characters separate points of every abelian group
statement: Work in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $G$ be an abelian group, written additively, and let $x\in G$ with $x\ne0$. There exists an additive group homomorphism $\chi:G\to\mathbf Q/\mathbf Z$ such that $\chi(x)\ne0$, where $\mathbf Q/\mathbf Z$ is the additive group of rational numbers modulo the subgroup of integers. No finiteness or torsion hypothesis is imposed on $G$.

source.place: Tag 01DB, lemma-ev-injective, proof: the character of the cyclic subgroup generated by a nonzero element extends to a character nonzero on that element. Apply with R = Z.
